**Problem statement:**
[What is the frustration or the missing capability? What are you trying to do that the viewer makes hard or impossible today?]

**Proposed behavior:**
[What should the viewer do, and where does it live — a gesture, a toolbar control, a menu entry, an Options page, a command-line switch?]

**Alternatives considered:**
[How you work around it today; other viewers that do this and how they do it; why the workaround falls short]

**Notes:**
This fork's focus areas are touch/gesture support, rendering (the GDI/OpenGL/Direct3D pipeline, the dark UI) and localization (English / 简体中文) — proposals in those areas fit the fork best. Anything else is still welcome, but consider whether it belongs upstream in [voidtools/voidImageViewer](https://github.com/voidtools/voidImageViewer) instead.
